records.observed_variable: choice distribution across attribute-conflict sets including intermediate compromise option
records.ambiguity: Middle-option selection alone does not establish compromise mechanism unless set structure and conflict are controlled.

records.observed_variable: confidence rating attached to a specific judgment plus accuracy/calibration when ground truth is available
records.ambiguity: Confidence target must be specified; high confidence is not high accuracy.

records.observed_variable: reference-resolution or discourse-inference accuracy/latency under controlled antecedent/coherence manipulations
records.ambiguity: Inference and reference resolution are affected by discourse and memory constraints; one task is not exhaustive.

records.observed_variable: receiver judgments or behavior under randomized concession versus no-concession/two-sided message structures
records.ambiguity: Concession effect depends on content, refutation and audience; cannot be isolated from all two-sidedness mechanisms in every design.
